The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] maintained a '''Military HQ''' in [[Tasariq City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tasariq]]. Three [[Company/Legends|companies]] of [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] [[Imperial Army trooper/Legends|soldiers]] were stationed at the HQ, along with a detachment of [[Internal Security Branch]] [[Soldier/Legends|troopers]].<ref name="J15" />
